propositions: Define and retain a documentation ownership policy covering eight documentation categories: tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence, with specified audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, citation, correction, and exclusion guidance for each.

Restore approved writing guidance (connectors, colons, hyphens, paragraphs, diction, filler, formal voice, authenticity-padding) as non-binding authoring guidance explicitly labeled as not defining a deterministic validator or gate contract.

Relocate generated artifact inventory from docs/README.md to docs/generated-artifacts.md and repoint all catalog consumers including tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py while preserving GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED enforcement sources.

Preserve Protected forms safeguard covering licenses, quotations, captures, frozen output, serialized fixtures, technical syntax, wording fixtures, generated outputs, historical ticket events, ADR decision substance, and protected evidence without introducing new deterministic prose, character, word, punctuation, or paragraph validators.

Add concise policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md describing documentation ownership, correction, and writing-guidance policy without portraying guidance as a deterministic gate.
Maintain ticket events as append-only and require ADR corrections through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement ADRs without erasing decision substance.
